name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? Synn. What are you doing here?」

name: Synn
message: 「I should be asking you that, Nanaka. Why are you here?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, me? Um, I'm meeting up with Sacchin」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't tell me... are you meeting Sacchin too, Synn?」
I came because she said she wanted to talk about Nanaka, though...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin... could it be she did this for me?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um... can I sit next to you?」
I scooted over to the right side of the bench.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just the two of us side by side on a bench! What a great situation」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Geez, what a pain, calling people out here and then not even showing up!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I bet she got the time wrong」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh well, guess we'll just wait together for a bit, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「What's up, Nanaka? Doing a fist pump like that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, by the way, where's Paa today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, Sacchin told me not to bring him along」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder what she wanted to talk about?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, ah, um, just going shopping together for a bit」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. That makes even less sense. Then why call me out here?」

name: Synn
message: 「She said she had something to talk to me about regarding you, Nanaka, so I came, but」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh. Is that so. Wonder what it could be?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nope, nope, nope. I'm sure it's no big deal!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, going out of her way to call me out here, and even keeping Paqy out of the picture」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um, well, that's, you know, maybe she was just in that kind of mood?」

name: Synn
message: 「You really don't have any idea either, Nanaka?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe it was some super serious advice she really wanted to keep secret……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When we finally have a chance to be alone together……」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, did you leave your phone behind?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-That's not it! Yeah! I'll try calling!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here, just pretend to call, pretend to call……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Looks like she's either out of range or has her phone turned off」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bad? She probably just has her phone turned off, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be! She got caught up in some incident and can't answer the phone!」

name: Synn
message: 「But we're talking about spacey little Sacchin here! What if a stranger lured her away with candy or something!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you worried, Nanaka? Or do you have some idea where she is?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are we talking about Sacchin…… ugh……」

name: Synn
message: 「I know! Why don't you try calling her house?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here, just pretend to call, pretend to call……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes. Hello. This is Yugiri. Is Sachiho-san there?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, yes. I see. Please tell her to take care of herself」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She came down with a fever and is stuck in bed」

name: Synn
message: 「For Sacchin of all people to catch a cold! It must be a really nasty one!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know where Sacchin's house is, so show me the way」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll go home and get some vegetables or something as a get-well gift……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um, Sacchin's family is actually super strict, even if they don't look it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah. So if a boy goes over, her old man will throw a huge fit. It'll just cause trouble for Sacchin too」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan. If you've got the time to come up with excuses like that, why aren't you making a move?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if you spring that on me all of a sudden……」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even though I went through all the trouble of setting this up」

name: Sacchin
message: 「At this rate, you really are headed straight for the 80-year-old course」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even I need to mentally prepare myself!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And when do you think you'll be ready~?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Geez, if it's come to this, I'll just take care of it myself~. Brace yourself~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-hey, what are you thinking, wait, ah」
The two of their faces rapidly closed in on each other!
Nanaka stood there stunned with her eyes wide and her mouth hanging open.
No response. It's just like a corpse.
Sacchin looked at me with the eyes of a panda eyeing bamboo leaves.
Sacchin's hands rested on my shoulders.

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean 'this too'!? W-whaaat, h-hey, hold on」
Why is Sacchin's face getting bigger and bigger?
Is it getting bigger because she's getting closer to my face?
Ah, I see. Isn't that simple.
Wait, hold on, why is she coming closer?

name: Sacchin
message: 「So you see, Nana-chan's first kiss and Synn-kun's first kiss are an indirect kiss~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What the heck is that supposed to meaaaaan!」
I see...... So that's what kissing a girl is like...... Amazing......

name: Sacchin
message: 「I was being considerate in my own way, you know~ If Synn-kun and I kissed first, it would've caused all sorts of problems, so I kissed Nana-chan first~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's the big idea stealing Synn's first kiss like that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Like I said~, I already got my first kiss out of the way with Nana-chan beforehand~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「In other words, this is my second, so Nana-chan's first and Synn-kun's first are indirect~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even if it's indirect, it's still the first kiss for the two of you~ For me it's my second time, so there's no problem~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What kind of crazy logic is that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, Nana-chan, if left alone you wouldn't do anything at all~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even indirect, a first is still a first~ Do you get it too, Synn-kun~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn is staring dreamily at Sacchin's face!」
